title: Machine with a Released Anchor State
statement: Given a deterministic Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$, and a chosen state $a\in S$, there is a machine with state set $\{\ast\}\sqcup S$ whose initial state is $\ast$. In state $\ast$ it uses the transition of $M$ at $a$, and in state $s\in S$ it uses the transition of $M$ at $s$; in both cases it preserves the input-head movement, work-tape actions, and output, and any successor state is placed in the $S$ summand.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A machine $M$ with that alphabet, state set, and $k$ work tapes
